Review result: Direct tract and linked community-area quartiles disagreed for 255 of 722 hypertension tracts (35.3%) and 206 of 411 COPD tracts (50.1%). Within-community variation accounted for 0.195 of observed tract variation in hypertension and 0.469 in COPD. In the secondary cross-source analysis, Spearman rho was 0.880 for hypertension and 0.739 for COPD.
Main limitation: PLACES is not a truth standard; metric-specific samples differ; tracts cluster within areas.
Needed supplement or decision: Approve 1000 cluster-bootstrap replicates, tie rules, and compatible source-uncertainty analysis.
